Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.United As One for Patients, our purpose in Healthcare is to help create, improve and prolong lives. We develop medicines, intelligent devices and innovative technologies in therapeutic areas such as Oncology, Neurology and Fertility. Our teams work together across 6 continents with passion and relentless curiosity in order to help patients at every stage of life. Joining our Healthcare team is becoming part of a diverse, inclusive and flexible working culture, presenting great opportunities for personal development and career advancement across the globe.Your Role:At the intersection of science, strategy, and commercial impact, this role places you at the heart of some of the most consequential decisions in healthcare drug development and commercialization. As an Associate Director within the Global Strategic Insights function, you will serve as a trusted thought partner to therapy area commercial teams — translating complex market dynamics into clear, actionable intelligence that shapes how healthcare assets are launched, grown, and managed across major global markets.This role will interact primarily with the Rare Tumor and Specialty Therapy Area teams, partnering closely with colleagues who are driving some of the most strategically significant assets in the portfolio.You will own the end-to-end delivery of insights across one or more GSI disciplines (primary market research, competitive intelligence, or strategic forecasting), ensuring every recommendation is grounded in rigorous analysis and directly informs critical business decisions.Working with cross-functional partners across commercial strategy, market access and pricing, other GSI functions, and regional insights teams, you will drive insights that elevate decision quality at critical stages of the asset lifecycle.Who You Are :- A degree in life sciences, business, economics, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience — is required.- 5 or more years of experience in at least one global strategic insights discipline — primary market research, competitive intelligence, data analytics, or strategic forecasting — ideally within the pharmaceutical or biopharma industry.- You have designed and led insights and KPI workstreams for in-market or launch assets, with at least 2 years of direct experience across pre-launch, launch, and post-launch phases.- You hold deep expertise in one or more of the following: qualitative and quantitative primary market research (study design, discussion guide development, strategic recommendations); global competitive intelligence (trial monitoring, congress coverage, strategic simulation); or topline forecasting (model building, opportunity assessment, scenario analysis).- You have global experience across two or more major markets — such as the US, China, EU4 and UK, or Japan — and bring a nuanced understanding of how market dynamics differ across regions.- You work effectively across functions, with a solid understanding of how commercial strategy, market access and pricing, and regional insights teams each contribute to asset success.- You are comfortable navigating the full medicine lifecycle — from proof-of-concept through in-market management — and understand how insights activities evolve at each stage.- You communicate complex findings with clarity and confidence, translating analytical outputs into compelling narratives that resonate with senior stakeholders and drive informed decisions.- English fluent, additional languages are a plusWhat we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

In this permanent full-time role based in Bad Homburg, you create transparency, manage risks and help turn complex transformation plans into disciplined execution.Your responsibilities- Own detailed planning, milestone tracking and RAID management for assigned workstreams- Maintain program documentation and keep records audit-ready throughout delivery- Apply governance standards, templates and change control processes consistently- Prepare clear status reports and executive-ready materials for key governance meetings- Consolidate workstream progress and highlight risks, issues and dependencies early- Coordinate blockers and follow up actions across business, IT, deployment and partner teams- Facilitate workstream governance meetings with structured agendas and outcomes- Align deliverables with Global Process Owners, transversal teams, SAP, Infosys and consulting partners- Support country deployment alignment and connect workstream and deployment activities- Build strong relationships across Fresenius and partner organizations to foster collaborationYour qualifications- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline- At least 10 years of experience in complex global business transformation programs- Strong experience with SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA transformation programs- Proven success in cross-functional, geographically distributed project environments- Experience in executive support, governance, stakeholder management and organizational change- Strong skills in planning, dependency management, RAID management, structured reporting and change control- Business-fluent English; German language skills are a plus- PMP, PRINCE2 or MSP certification and experience in Life Sciences, Healthcare or another regulated industry are desirable- Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to create executive-ready reporting- Highly organized, proactive and collaborative, with calm execution focus during high-intensity phases such as cutover or go-liveWhat we offerHelp shape the future of Fresenius business transformation, join #futurefresenius and apply now through our online portal to make an impact!ContactApply now (https://apply.jcd.de/Apply.php?iJobAdID=107473&tc=3-11)

jobs.occupation: Managing Consultant Global IT Vendor Management (m/f/d) (Global-Sourcing-Manager/in)
jobs.description: Introduction/About usGroup IT Strategy, Sourcing & Transformation shapes and supports the execution of the One IT vision across Fresenius. The department brings together IT procurement, strategic sourcing, vendor management, enterprise architecture, IT governance and service management to strengthen collaboration, ensure compliance and harmonize IT processes across the Group.We are looking for an experienced Managing Consultant for Global IT Vendor Management (m/f/d) to lead the strategy, governance, commercial performance and executive relationships for selected strategic IT vendors. In this role, you will help protect contractual value, improve supplier performance, coordinate commercial and third-party risks, and ensure that strategic vendor relationships deliver measurable and sustainable business outcomes.Your responsibilities- Vendor strategy: Develop and maintain short- and long-term strategies for assigned strategic IT vendors, with measurable objectives covering cost optimization, service performance, technology adoption, innovation, contractual protection, flexibility and overall value.- Contract lifecycle: Coordinate contractual obligations, commercial milestones, amendments, change orders, renewals, termination planning and exit readiness. Maintain a forward-looking renewal pipeline and ensure that contractual decisions receive the approvals and signatures required under applicable company policies.- Commercial governance: Monitor spend, consumption, commitments, pricing mechanisms, indexation, credits, penalties, caps, thresholds and other contractual levers. Identify potential commercial leakage and optimization opportunities and coordinate approved actions with Finance, Procurement, product owners and vendors.- Vendor performance: Establish and operate vendor scorecards covering service, commercial, financial, risk, innovation and stakeholder dimensions. Validate performance information, identify root causes and trends, and coordinate corrective and continuous-improvement plans.- Governance: Design and facilitate strategic, tactical and operational governance forums with appropriate participants, decision rights, escalation paths, agendas, cadence and documented actions. Lead executive Quarterly Business Reviews and track agreed commitments through to closure.- Sourcing and negotiations: Partner with Strategic Sourcing, Procurement, Legal and other relevant functions on sourcing events, renewals and complex negotiations. Conduct market analysis, benchmarking and commercial scenario modelling and prepare decision-ready business cases for the applicable approval bodies.- Third-party risk: Maintain a consolidated view of vendor-related risks and coordinate assessments, reporting and remediation with accountable functions such as Information Security, Data Protection, Compliance, Legal, Finance, Procurement and Business Continuity. Escalate material risks through the applicable governance channels.- Stakeholder relationships: Act as a primary commercial and governance interface between assigned strategic vendors and internal stakeholders. Facilitate cross-functional decisions, manage escalations and translate complex commercial, performance and risk matters into clear recommendations.Your qualifications- Substantial relevant experience in strategic IT vendor management, technology sourcing, contract and commercial management, procurement or a comparable supplier-governance role in a complex international organization.- Demonstrated experience managing complex and strategically important IT contracts or vendor portfolios, including commercial governance, service levels, contractual obligations, renewals, disputes and exit provisions.- Strong commercial and contractual expertise, including negotiation, benchmarking, business-case development, cost optimization and the application of contractual value levers.- Experience establishing and operating vendor-performance and governance frameworks, including scorecards, KPIs, SLAs, executive reviews, improvement plans and escalation processes.- A sound understanding of third-party risk management, including supplier due diligence, information security, data protection, compliance, financial risk and operational resilience.- Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a matrix organization, influence senior internal and supplier stakeholders, resolve complex escalations and facilitate decisions without relying on direct authority.- Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to interpret commercial, financial, performance and risk information and present clear recommendations to senior stakeholders.- Business-fluent English, required for global stakeholder and vendor engagement. German language skills are an advantage for collaborating with stakeholders based in Germany.What we offerShape strategic technology partnerships that deliver measurable value, resilient services and controlled risk across Fresenius — join #futurefresenius and make an impact!ContactApply now through our online portal to submit your application.
